description: Types text into the specified editable target, optionally clearing its current value first. If a dialog or file chooser interrupts typing, the final field value may be unconfirmed and should be read again after handling it.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the editable target.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the editable target.

id.description: Current node ID from the latest page observation for the editable target. Refresh it after navigation or document replacement.

text.description: Text to type into the target.

clear.description: Clear existing content before typing when true.

purpose.description: Describe why this exact text is being entered, such as filling a search query, username, password, or form field.

resolvedBy.description: Actor or resolution mode that selected the target.

cleared.description: Whether the target value was cleared before typing.

characterCount.description: Number of characters reported as dispatched. It may be omitted when an interruption prevents confirmation.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

dialog.description: Interactive native dialog returned while typing; handled page alerts are not returned here. Re-read the field after the dialog is handled.

id.description: ID of an interactive native dialog returned for Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether native dialog text was truncated.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
